Retain nitrogen emission and all three separate water-resource/return flows in exact canonical3.10 compartments by verified publisher UUID; no collapse into one net-water exchange. The source inventory includes generic waste treatment and water assumptions beyond the public liquid-plant description; retain them without asserting plant-measured equivalence. No new recovery credit, omitted source exchange, renormalization or arbitrary unit multiplier.
